facts.text: Williams offers tutorial courses modeled on Oxford, pairing two students with one professor for weekly discussions and debate.

sources.title: Tutorials - Williams College
sources.quote: Two students. One professor. An in-depth conversation fueled by intellectual curiosity and the spirit of debate. Our tutorial classes offer an academic experience you won't find at most other colleges.
